receipt_storage.retention: Sandbox temporary storage; not guaranteed to survive a new session.
receipt_storage.resume_boundary: Reuse only sealed jobs with exact source/environment/engine/settings compatibility. If receipts are missing, rerun; this summary and its hashes are not substitutes for receipts.

aggregation_boundary: Product tests overlap full-core tests; do not add their counts or combine incompatible environments.
